useCase: Detección de imágenes compuestas, reemplazos de fondo y ensamblaje de imágenes de múltiples fuentes
mechanism: Analiza transition boundaries entre potential spliced regions for unnatural edges, nivel de ruido discontinuities, and iluminación direction inconsistencias. Utiliza sliding window approach to segment and compare local image statistics.
accuracy: Medium - 75-85% depending on empalme quality and post-processing applied
name: Deteccion de empalme
parameters: Tamaño de ventana: 64x64, Overlap: 50%, Noise model: Gaussian, Boundary detección: Canny edge with adaptativo umbral
description: Identifica regions spliced from different sources mediante el análisis de boundary inconsistencias, nivel de ruidos, and iluminación differences a través de image regions.

references.title: Hsu, Y.F. & Chang, S.F. (2006). Detecting Image Splicing Using Geometry Invariants and Camera Characteristics Consistency. IEEE ICME.
Dong, J. et al. (2013). CASIA Image Tampering Detection Evaluation Database. IEEE ChinaSIP.

strengths:
• Detecta composite images from multiple sources
• Analiza both noise and iluminación consistency
• Can localize spliced boundaries
• Effective for manual manipulación de imagen
limitations:
• Skilled compositing can minimize boundary artefactos
• Uniform backgrounds reduce detección capability
• Heavy blur/feathering masks splice boundaries
• Full-image AI generation has no splice boundaries
